title: Director of Workforce Solutions and Partnerships
description:
Pinnacle Group exists to connect people with opportunity. For the last 25 years, we've done exactly that by living our core values of putting people first, delivering excellence in all we do, and giving back to the communities in which we live and work. We are a leading workforce solutions company supporting the talent needs of global leaders in financial services, technology, communications, utilities, and transportation and we are one of the largest women and minority-owned companies in our industry. Our team of service-driven, energetic, and diverse professionals is well-respected in our industry and our leadership team is aligned and focused on taking the company to the next level. If you're looking for a new opportunity where you can truly make a difference, we hope you'll apply for a position with us.
Job Summary

• Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy to retain, strengthen, and expand PTR Global’s portfolio of MSP program relationships.

• Cultivate trusted relationships with procurement leaders, program executives, workforce solution partners, and other stakeholders who influence supplier participation and program growth.

• Identify opportunities to increase PTR Global’s market share, service offerings, geographic reach, and overall performance within existing accounts.

• Pursue entry into new MSP programs by leveraging industry expertise, established relationships, strategic networking, and consultative business development.

• Position PTR Global as a strategic workforce solutions partner by identifying client challenges and recommending solutions that improve talent access, supplier performance, and workforce outcomes.

• Create account growth plans, relationship maps, opportunity pipelines, and executive engagement strategies for priority programs.

• Partner with sales, recruiting, delivery, operations, and executive leadership to ensure commitments are executable and client relationships remain strong after expansion.

• Monitor program performance, market activity, procurement trends, competitive positioning, and relationship health to identify risks and growth opportunities.

• Negotiate partnership opportunities and commercial arrangements that support sustainable revenue and net growth.

• Travel regularly to meet with MSP partners, procurement stakeholders, clients, and other strategic contacts.

• Deliver consistent year-over-year growth and demonstrate the leadership capability required to progress into Senior Director and Vice President-level responsibilities.

Qualifications

• Significant experience in MSP, workforce solutions, staffing, contingent labor, procurement, supplier management, or a closely related field.

• Established relationships within the MSP and workforce procurement ecosystem, with the ability to develop access to decision-makers and program stakeholders.

• Demonstrated success expanding existing accounts, entering new programs, developing partnerships, or growing revenue within complex enterprise environments.

• Strong understanding of MSP operating models, supplier participation, procurement processes, workforce program structures, and account growth strategies.

• Consultative selling skills with the ability to identify workforce challenges, develop solutions, and communicate a compelling business case.

• Proven ability to balance relationship management, account retention, upselling, and new business development responsibilities.

• Strong executive presence, negotiation skills, commercial judgment, and cross-functional leadership capabilities.

• Entrepreneurial and results-oriented mindset with a genuine enthusiasm for relationship building, pursuing opportunities, and performance-based success.

• Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time.

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING
Location: Remote

Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

Our client is an early-stage FinTech developing technology for businesses operating within an increasingly digital and international financial environment.
As the business progresses from early product development towards greater commercial readiness, it is building out its senior leadership team and is seeking an experienced Fractional Chief Product Officer .
The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder/CEO and engineering leadership to turn an ambitious proposition into a focused, commercially viable product strategy.
This is a build-stage opportunity. You will not be inheriting a large Product organisation, mature roadmap or established Product infrastructure.
The opportunity therefore requires someone capable of combining strategic Product leadership with practical decision-making and execution.
Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter answering each of the following:

• What senior Product leadership experience do you have within FinTech, financial services or complex B2B technology?

• Please provide a specific example of a product you personally helped take from concept, prototype or early development towards commercial deployment.

• What experience do you have translating a founder-led or technically complex proposition into a prioritised product roadmap?

• What experience do you have with product pricing, packaging and commercialisation?

• Do you have experience within trade finance, payments, lending, banking, financial infrastructure, Web3/blockchain or another relevant financial-services environment? Please explain.

• This opportunity requires approximately 6-8 hours per week . Can you consistently commit to this alongside your other professional commitments?

All six questions are mandatory. Applications that do not answer every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not progress further.
What You'll Be Doing
You will help establish and lead the company's Product discipline, including:

• Owning and refining product strategy and roadmap

• Translating commercial opportunities into clear product priorities

• Defining requirements and use cases

• Working closely with engineering leadership

• Supporting product positioning, packaging and pricing

• Prioritising integrations and product opportunities

• Supporting pilot and proof-of-concept development

• Bringing customer and institutional requirements into product decision-making

• Establishing scalable Product-management disciplines

• Helping leadership distinguish immediate priorities from longer-term opportunities

What We're Looking For
You should bring substantial Product leadership experience, strong commercial instincts and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.
Experience within FinTech, payments, lending, trade finance, banking infrastructure, financial APIs, Web3/blockchain or other complex regulated technology environments would be particularly valuable.
We are more interested in evidence of what you have personally built, influenced and commercialised than job title alone .
Engagement Structure
This is a fractional engagement of approximately 6-8 hours per week , designed to operate alongside other compatible professional commitments.
The structure is centred on longer-term participation in the development and growth of an early-stage venture rather than a conventional executive package at this stage.
Full details will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore  EvalOps : the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

• Regression suites : How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

• Coverage estimation : How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

• Live monitoring : Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

• Eval analysis : How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

• Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

• Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

• Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

• Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

• Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

• Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar
Driving question

What should we build?
Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering
How should we build it?
Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science
How do we know it works?
Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

Role Overview
We are seeking an AI Researcher with deep experience in inference optimization to design, evaluate, and deploy high-performance inference systems for large-scale machine learning models. You will work at the intersection of model architecture, systems engineering, and hardware-aware optimization , improving latency, throughput, and cost efficiency across real-world production environments.

• Research and develop techniques to optimize inference performance for large neural networks.

• Benchmark inference workloads across hardware accelerators.

• Translate research insights into production-ready improvements .

• Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, or AI systems .

• Hands-on experience optimizing inference for large-scale models .

• Ability to design experiments and communicate results clearly.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Experience deploying production inference systems at scale .

• Familiarity with distributed and multi-GPU inference .

• Experience contributing to open-source ML or inference frameworks .

• Authorship or co-authorship of peer-reviewed research papers in machine learning, systems, or related fields.

• Experience working close to hardware (CUDA, ROCm, profiling tools).

What Success Looks Like

• Measurable gains in latency, throughput, and cost efficiency .

• Optimized inference systems running reliably in production.

• Research ideas successfully translated into deployable systems.

• Clear benchmarks and documentation that inform product decisions.
